text.title: Periods
text.text: Training to 31 Mar 2025; ranking 1 Apr - 31 Dec 2025 (the lab's untouched test period); the vault 1 Jan - 9 Oct 2026, which the search never sees; the live paper trades start on 10 Oct 2026.

text.title: P1 Lab scoring
text.text: Within the 40 % drawdown limit in training and ranking, at least 30 training and 20 ranking trades, made money in ranking, no too-good-to-be-true flag, still profitable without its best coin, and runnable by a paper bot (price data only).

text.title: P2 Vault
text.text: At least 10 vault trades, made money, drawdown within 40 %, and a Sharpe above the vault luck bar, which rises with every candidate ever checked on the vault.

text.title: P3 Beats the weakest bot
text.text: Higher monthly return than the weakest live bot on both the ranking period and the vault, compared on the same dates.

text.title: P4 Different
text.text: Training daily returns correlate below 0.9 with every live bot.

text.title: Slots
text.text: At most 7 bots (arm A + 6 lab bots), at most 1 promotion and 2 retirements per cycle; a bot must run 14 days before a better candidate can replace it.

text.title: R1 Live shortfall
text.text: After 20 closed paper trades, retire if live returns per trade are clearly below the backtest's (t-statistic -2 or lower).

text.title: R2 Live drawdown
text.text: Retire if the paper account falls further from its peak than the tighter of 40 % and 1.5 times its worst backtest drawdown.

text.title: R3 Updated backtest
text.text: Retire if a re-run on the newest data leaves the 40 % drawdown limit, in training, ranking or since 1 Jan 2026 (the vault and the live period together).

text.title: A1 Arm A
text.text: Judged like any bot, but only after 24 Oct 2026 has ended and the Phase B 14-day verdict is recorded.

text.title: Novelty
text.text: Rejected if the same building blocks with every number within 15 %, or training weekly returns correlating 0.95 or more, match anything already tested.

text.title: AI
text.text: Weekly, at least 5 ideas, cheapest model first, hard cap $10 a month enforced before every call.

findings.text: 43 simulated trades so far across 6 live and 7 retired bots (20 closed, 8 still open, 15 left open when their bots were retired): 2 won, 18 lost, -635.97 USD net after 122.59 USD of fees on the closed trades.
Lab bot 2 is ahead: +9.02 USD over 1 closed trade (1 won).
Lab bot 5 is furthest behind: -393.09 USD over 11 closed trades (0 won).
Fees: 122.59 USD in all. Before fees the closed trades made -513.38 USD; after fees -635.97 USD. Kraken charges 0.4-0.8 % a side, so a trade must move about 1 % just to break even.
Fills: entries averaged 0.00 % from the requested price, exits 0.01 % worse than requested.
Not enough trades yet to compare market conditions (needs 5 each side; BTC above its 200-day average: 20, below: 0).
Trades closed by its sell rule averaged -5.88 % (18 trades), the weakest exit so far.

summary.text: This week's Learning Brain tested 8 AI ideas and evolved none. One idea passed the lab scoring on the untouched test months. Across 6 live and 7 retired bots there have been 43 simulated trades. 20 are closed, 8 are open and 15 were left open at retirement. Of the closed trades, 2 won and 18 lost, for -635.97 USD net after 122.59 USD in fees. Before fees the loss was -513.38 USD. Lab bot 2 is ahead at +9.02 USD, and lab bot 5 is furthest behind at -393.09 USD.
